Était defined as are; correct tense metadata and copula/auxiliary roles.
Donna la vie spared life, donna un bal hosted an event, donna une paire gave an object; single property-transfer definition does not cover all.
Eût includes imperfect subjunctive eût affaire and literary conditional-perfect alternative elle eût désiré. Define auxiliary uses accurately before approving.
Le direct-object singular definition incorrectly says one or more; also neutral proposition le répète. Correct metadata and roles.
Font shares definition referring to fait and faire des pas, but occurrences accomplish/make for oneself/transform into. Correct faire senses.

Quatre cardinal number incorrectly tagged verb.
Ellébore plant noun incorrectly tagged verb. Fix before noun-only agreement-safe distractors.
Non negative adverb incorrectly tagged verb; gap also allows oui.
Fait action sense includes se fait fort and il ne fait pas bon, beyond faire des pas definition. Repair shared faire mappings.
Causative fait includes fait des bureaux l’arche, transformation without infinitive, under specifically fait arpenter. Clarify causal/transformation roles.
Mit includes lexical put and se mit à inchoative began. Split usage.
Quel includes exclamative quel nid/quel coup as well as interrogative which. Define and map roles.
Faire generic infinitive carries narrow definition fait makes/takes in faire des pas; many causal/idiomatic constructions need accurate sense metadata.
Ceux defined as singular the one; correct plural meaning these/those/the ones.
Être infinitive defined as are, includes passive auxiliary/copying state. Correct metadata and roles.
Atteint participle carries definition of atteindrez second plural future. Correct inflection metadata and caught/reached context.
Renvoie aux calendes means indefinitely postpones/defeats pursuit, not literal sends back. Review idiomatic assignment.
Leur mixes possessive determiner and indirect object pronoun; definition incorrectly calls possessive pronoun. Separate roles.
Dis first/second singular has shared definition says (third singular); correct inflection metadata.
Écouter infinitive defined listens to rather than to listen; also gap entendre correct. Correct metadata and gap together.
Vient includes motion/origin and recent-past vient de; split auxiliary role before approval.
Part departure verb includes noun faire part des oranges (share). Split homographs and correct infinitive-based metadata.
Va combines lexical goes, near future and il y va de stakes expression. Split roles and inaccurate infinitive definition.
Autre pronoun identity tagged adjective; fix POS and bad early distractor another door as adjective.
Fit shares definition specifically fait faire des pas, but source includes causative fit éclater and monetary writing of bills. Correct faire senses.
